basic_info.description: Welcome to your dream home nestled in the heart of Central Sunset, where classic charm meets modern convenience. This residence offers approximately 1,150 square feet of living space, including 2 spacious bedrooms and 1 stylish bathroom, offering the perfect blend of relaxation and functionality. The kitchen serves as an inviting haven with its timeless decor, generous cabinet storage, and a welcoming breakfast nook. Countertops and flooring enhance its appeal, making it the ideal setting for both intimate meals and lively gatherings. Each bedroom offers serene ocean and sunset views, promising a tranquil retreat at the end of the day. Imagine the potential of the expansive lower levelperfect for a creative studio or to develop into additional living space. Step outside to discover a private backyard oasis, lushly landscaped with artificial turf and great to play on. This home's location in Central Sunset puts you within easy reach of vibrant shops, eateries, and the lively Noriega business corridor. Commuting is effortless with excellent public transportation links and major thoroughfares nearby, and you'll find yourself moments away from iconic sights like the Golden Gate Bridge, Sunset Reservoir, and Sunset Playground. Embrace the opportunity to own this delightful home!
